title: Docs and design for the mix in DAW sets (device mapping table, --no-measure)
description:
## Intent

Docs and design for the mix in the set.

## Steps

- `design/daw-set.md`: the device mapping table, every parameter's conversion, what is left out or approximated; mark rows built. Cross-link from `design/mixer.md`.
- `docs/concepts.md` "Taking a score into a DAW": the mix (groups, returns, devices, sidechain, master and loudness) and where it differs from the render.
- `docs/tools.md`: `--no-measure`.

## Verification

The diff adds no mention of the vendor's name or the DAW's product name; docs render in the web app.

## Release

`docs(<this task's id>): the mix in DAW sets`.
